subject: Citations under `docs/` resolve nowhere, and nothing reads them
recordedOccasion: while reading the tree to design the allocation architecture.
severity: low each, and F1 is the first demonstrated instance of `0036` — a broken link inside `docs/` that every validator passes.
feltAt: `docs/cross-cutting-findings/INDEX.md` rows 0003, 0005, 0006 and 0030; line 15 of the same file; `docs/sessions/INDEX.md` line 8
scope: the two index files. No script changes.
read: `bin/verify-doc-paths.sh`, and its `--all` run over 778 paths and 1108 anchors

members.statement: Four session citations in one index point one directory too high and resolve to nothing
members.sectionHeading: F1 — four citations resolve one directory too high

resolution.whatWasDone: docs/cross-cutting-findings/INDEX.md — eight Session cells changed from ../../sessions/ to ../sessions/; grep -c for the broken spelling in that file returns 0

members.statement: Two indexes cite an instruction file section that moved when the set was split
members.sectionHeading: F2 — two indexes cite a file section that moved

resolution.whatWasDone: docs/cross-cutting-findings/INDEX.md and docs/sessions/INDEX.md stopped citing .github/copilot-instructions.md sections 4c and 4d and now cite .github/session-management-instructions.md sections 2, 3 and 5

decisions.decision: The eight broken citations are repaired now, as a record write. The repair is undone by the next writer until the check exists, and saying so is the argument for building it
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — repair the eight, and say what the repair does not buy

decisions.decision: A citation to a rule that moved is repaired; a citation to a record's own moment is marked historical and never repaired. F2 is the first kind
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — repair what moved, mark what is frozen

decisions.decision: The check 0041 D1 specifies is not built here. It is a toolkit write with no bundle type yet
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — the check is specified here and built elsewhere

edges.why: both are drift a check would catch, found by looking rather than by a checker
